## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) ABOVE TREND show pockets of strength while VXX (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) RECOVERY and HYG (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.83%) CORRECTION signal mixed sentiment.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Tech/semis leadership: SOXX (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) ABOVE TREND driving equity gains. Credit and volatility neutral-to-mixed: HYG (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.83%) CORRECTION and VXX (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Duration mildly firmer: TLT (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +0.25%) CORRECTION suggesting slightly higher yields; credit neutral: LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +1.21%) CORRECTION. Dollar broadly neutral in the dataset (no strong directional ETF signal).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Technology leading: XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) ABOVE TREND; Energy mixed but rallying: XLE (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -6.11%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +15.66% | 1M: +7.83%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare lagging: XLV (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US leadership but not uniform: SPY (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +12.94%) ABOVE TREND outperform EEM (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +11.01%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +2.39%) CORRECTION in China.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Risk appetite present but selective: IWM (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +9.86%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +0.18% | 1M: +9.58%) ABOVE TREND, while ARKK (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +9.44%) CORRECTION shows profit-taking in high-beta innovation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Oil and energy commodities strong: USO (1W: +14.10% | 1M: +16.77%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +15.66% | 1M: +7.83%) ABOVE TREND; copper mixed: CPER (1W: -0.94% | 1M: +9.32%) CORRECTION. Gold taking a pullback: GLD (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +4.07%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy rally with dispersion: XLE (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -6.11%) RECOVERY and BNO ABOVE TREND (see above) while gas remains weak: UNG (1W: -4.89% | 1M: -13.07%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Tech/semis (XLK and SOXX both ABOVE TREND) provide coherent upside. DIVERGENCE: several sector ETFs show 1W vs 1M mismatches (XBI, XLY, XRT, VWO etc.) indicating MINOR divergence rather than a regime break.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor exposure to technology/semis and broad Nasdaq proxies (XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor defensive/lagging sectors (XLV (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND) for signs of broadening or deterioration.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Technology/semis — XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) ABOVE TREND if momentum holds. BEARISH: Healthcare/Comm — XLV (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND and Communication (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -2.96%) BELOW TREND if selling continues.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Oil complex — USO (1W: +14.10% | 1M: +16.77%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +15.66% | 1M: +7.83%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -4.89% | 1M: -13.07%) BELOW TREND and metals if GLD (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +4.07%) CORRECTION extends.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX 20 (volatility complacency trigger), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health indicator), XLK/ XLF spread (growth vs value pivot), SPY (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND as a health check for risk appetite.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, pockets of strength in Tech/Semis (XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) ABOVE TREND). Key risk: cross-sector 1W/1M divergences (XBI, XLY, XRT showing CORRECTIONs) that could keep markets range-bound — monitor volatility (VXX (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) RECOVERY) and credit spreads.
